text_block_list.text:
For now, the days aiming to run in the 
"Japanese Derby" began...

Right after the Satsuki Sho, she had said 
she couldn't guarantee entering the 
Japanese Derby, yet—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hah, hah... Phew...!

—For some reason, lately they've been 
training diligently without slacking off 
at all.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, what's that? Ah, is it that I actually 
showed up for training?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Of course I am. Because I want to run 
faster in races!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: No, I've always been an Umamusume, though.
choice_data_list:
I told you, I can't promise the Japan 
Derby...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I said I couldn't make any promises, not 
that I wouldn't run.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
One should be prepared for any and all 
situations, right?

"...As usual, she kept blowing smoke with 
an attitude whose true motives remained 
elusive, but—"

At any rate, it's wonderful that she's so 
proactive about training.

Just as today's training was wrapping up, 
I noticed Agnes Tachyon staring off at 
something in the distance.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: —Well, well. It seems she's still here.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Do you need something, Cafe?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You've been sending passionate glances my 
way for quite a while now! If this is a 
love confession, shall we head behind the 
school building or up to the roof?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: It's not like that...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...I was just a little concerned. Her 
running form... felt different from usual.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph?

At Manhattan Cafe's words, a slight 
flicker passed through Agnes Tachyon's 
eyes.

Yet that wavering vanished just as quickly 
behind a suspicious smile.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You've really been keeping your eyes on 
me, haven't you? Hehehe, that's actually 
kinda flattering!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...It's not like that at all. I was 
just—"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
There, there. You don't have to be so 
bashful, I understand. In other words, you 
want to assist in my research, is that it—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"It's just that your research...! Is 
useful... for catching up to that 
girl...!"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...I was merely observing you, that's 
all. ...Nothing more."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hmm? I wasn't aware of that.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...However, when I think about it, this 
has nothing to do with me. Farewell.

Agnes Tachyon stopped Manhattan Cafe just 
as she was about to leave.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: It might not be "unrelated" at all!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Because I've wagered a piece of my future 
on you, after all."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I actually hold you in quite high regard. 
Including that invisible "friend" of 
yours.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
At first, I thought we were two of a 
kind—a pair of outcasts... but I was 
wrong.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
How to put it... I feel like you possess 
every single quality that I could never 
have.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I even think it might be interesting to 
try living like you.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Please don't drag me into this.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
—Well then, I suppose it's about time for 
me to go too.

Before she left, there was something I 
wanted to confirm. There were many things 
on my mind, but above all—
choice_data_list:
What do you mean, you "changed your 
running style"?

text_block_list.text:
After hesitating for a moment, she gave a 
shrug.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hmm. Beats me what you're talking about.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, guinea pig. About our 
next race—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Judging by how you looked today, we should 
be good to aim for the Japan Derby as 
planned!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Somehow, right now—I'm feeling 
motivated.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"So stop wracking your brain over strange 
words and focus on the race!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
To gather good data, let's start coming up 
with countermeasures first thing tomorrow!

Leaving behind those words, Agnes Tachyon 
walked away.

—Many questions remain, but at any rate, 
if she declares it so clearly, there won't 
be any withdrawal from the Japanese Derby.

Steel yourself anew for the grand stage of 
early summer.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
As expected, the 'Japanese Derby' is a bit 
troublesome. To put it bluntly, I just 
can't get motivated for it.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Now, now, stop shouting like that. I 
would very much like to run in races too, 
you know. After all, I need to collect the 
data."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"And so, in its place, let's run in the 
'NHK Mile Cup'!"

"The NHK Mile Cup—a GⅠ mile race held in 
early summer."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: At that distance, my—

Agnes Tachyon started to say something, 
only to stop herself and close her mouth.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"No, it's nothing. At any rate, next is 
the NHK Mile Cup. Understood?"

"...Plenty of doubts remain, but 
regardless, if she's declaring it so 
clearly, she won't be backing out of the 
NHK Mile Cup."

Though our goal had changed— I shifted 
gears and fired myself up again to prepare 
for the upcoming race.
